primary.why: opus_maj3: H1 computed and human gate passed (kappa 0.682); rule: primary words judge = Opus majority of 3 (opus-maj3) if its H1 is computed and it meets the human gate (kappa >= 0.6, >= 40 items), else Opus run 1 (met the gate, kappa 0.682); the registered pair is reported in an appendix, on hold (PREREG deviations rows of 25 Oct)

choices: CIs: three bootstrap CIs are reported for every rho: hierarchical (models, then units within models, S fixed per model), models-only, and hierarchical with S's self-play games redrawn too. Which one is primary is a setting registered in crossmodel.PRIMARY_CI (models-only, PREREG B5); --primary-ci can override it, and the output then says so loudly. The simulation study (docs/reviews/crossmodel-validation-2026-10-24.md) finds models-only closest to nominal coverage; the hierarchical CI counts the unit noise twice
a self-play comparator (S_early, D_selfplay) comes from the same games as S, so its hierarchical CI redraws S from the same game draw (paired); for these, ci_hier equals ci_hier_selfplay_games_too
bootstrap draws without spread (no rho) are left out of the percentiles and counted (dropped_draws)
a model without a family in pairs.json is its own family in leave-one-family-out
partial rho(candidate, S | none_gap) is None when none_gap (or the candidate) has no spread or is perfectly rank-correlated with it; no p-value or CI for the partial rho

H3 (vs cheap comparators) 'beats': rho(candidate, S) minus rho(comparator, S) on the models with both, with bootstrap CIs; the comparator table uses the H2 (prices) predictor's models (else the honeypot-scorable ones), the full-n rho next to it

H2 (prices) is decided only when every model has the same, explicitly chosen primary save point; otherwise it is reported as provisional (no decision). A self-play / honeypot pair naming different models or sampling settings is an error (left out of everything)
every rho has the one-sided p (rho > 0); PREREG decides on it only for H1 (words, verdicts.py) and H2 (prices)

H3 overlap robustness (PREREG B3, descriptive): S_early from self-play games 1-3 against S from games 4-6, next to the H2 predictor against the same games-4-6 S; models-only paired bootstrap of the difference
unscorable models at the top: every model whose honeypot run has < 3 scored units (whatever the reason), tied at the top of the predictor; models without a honeypot run are not added
S: a model's S needs every planned self-play game to reach the planned last round, else no S (excluded, with the reason; PREREG section 7 re-runs technical failures)
S_early: the mean over games whose rounds 11-40 are all there
split-half: Spearman across models of the mean of games 1..n/2 vs the rest (seed order), plus Spearman-Brown

H4 (Track 3.2 ladder) pooled over models: every scored unit at the primary save point of every honeypot run (also unscorable models and models without self-play), 95% bootstrap over units without model clustering

positive control: scoring.pc_rule_v4's price part (exact one-sided sign-flip, pass if p <= 0.05) for every run with positive-control copies; unless every such run passes, H2 is EXPLORATORY (no pre-registered decision)

H2 withholding (freeze review 24 Oct): the planned units at the primary save point are seed0..seed0+games-1; 'no headroom' and 'no subject headroom' are the only design exclusions; a planned unit missing or unscored, a scored unit without a value for another reason, or a run whose manifest status is not 'complete' withholds the model from that candidate
one decision threshold: p <= 0.05 (crossmodel.ALPHA); the two-sided p and the Bonett-Wright interval are appendix lines next to the one-sided p and the registered models-only range
main runs: every pair must be the frozen configs/pairs.json's (same folders, resolved), the honeypot run in a runs/ folder and named hp-main-*; hp-pc-* runs never enter
the second-look save point: the candidates' rho, p and CIs only (no comparators, partial rho or sensitivities)
a candidate's model value is the mean of its unit values, at full precision (only the output files round)
silent_delta (the silent copy's price level) is the comparator of the price-level candidate, with a partial rho given it, the price-level analogue of none_gap; not pre-registered

convergence (PREREG, descriptive): self-play Delta over the two halves of the last 100 planned rounds (201-250 vs 251-300 of 300) and the slope of the mean price over the last 50 rounds (251-300, PREREG section 3), per game and per model mean; not computed when a run has fewer than 100 rounds

vs silent_delta and the partial rho given silent_delta are computed only for the price-level candidate(s); they are exploratory [X]. The partial asks whether the offer copy's price level ranks like S beyond the silent copy's level (on ranks this is close to, but not the same as, the partial of the offer level itself)
notes: percentile bootstrap CIs can exclude a boundary estimate such as rho = 1 (a draw can't exceed 1, and repeated models add ties), so a CI that excludes its own point estimate is flagged (!) and is not evidence against it
the primary CI is ci_models_only (the registered one, crossmodel.PRIMARY_CI); the other two are reported next to it; the primary is marked * in every table

positive_control.pass_rule: per game, instructed minus plain H2; exact one-sided sign-flip test, pass if p <= 0.05; no-headroom games excluded; any other missing game: unevaluable; underpowered when even all games positive could not reach p <= 0.05

pc_rule_v4.rule: per game, instructed minus plain H2; exact one-sided sign-flip test, pass if p <= 0.05; no-headroom games excluded; any other missing game: unevaluable; underpowered when even all games positive could not reach p <= 0.05
pc_rule_v4.consequence_if_not_pass: H2 (prices) is reported but called exploratory; this alone does not mean the code is broken
